newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 11.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on Friday:
WASHINGTON - The chairman of the House Banking Committee has called for an investigation of Freddie Mac's trading in tobacco company bonds.
NEW YORK - A former executive of the Bennett Funding Group Inc. pleaded guilty to criminal securities fraud, bankruptcy fraud, perjury and obstructing justice.
WASHINGTON - Top U.S. and Japanese economic officials signaled their concern over the recent rise in the dollar against the yen, causing the dollar to recede on currency markets.
CHARLOTTE - U.S. Airways' top management warned that unless cost-cutting labor agreements are worked out soon, the airline will be forced to begin slashing service.
